Qually test fixtures

Shared reference data for testing and bug reports. All timed fixtures use the same ground truth: twelve segments of exactly ten seconds each, covering 0:00 to 2:00. Segment n starts at 10 × (n − 1) seconds.

To report a bug, name the file, the segment number, and what you did — for example: “tone-check, segment 5, pressed Enter, heard four beeps instead of five.”

The tone-check set (use these together)

  • tone-check.vtt

    Transcript for the shared timeline. Each cue states its own segment number, beep count, and start time, with alternating Tester and Guide speakers.

  • tone-check.wav

    Two-minute audio: segment n begins with n short beeps, so you can verify any seek by counting beeps. A soft background tone rises one semitone per segment. About 1.9 megabytes. Attach it as this document’s media file.

  • segment-slides.webm

    Two-minute silent video showing the digit of the current segment on a distinct background color — the same timeline, for sighted verification. About 0.7 megabytes.

Other transcripts

  • interview-onboarding.srt

    Realistic eight-cue interview on the same ten-second grid (0:00–1:20) with “Interviewer:” and “P2:” speaker prefixes. The tone-check audio also works with it.

  • focus-group-notes.txt

    Timed plaintext with bracketed timestamps and four speakers; exercises the plaintext parsing path.

  • reflection-memo.txt

    Untimed paragraphs; exercises the no-timestamp path — pressing Enter on these segments should announce that there is no timestamp.

  • README.md

    This documentation as a file, kept alongside the fixtures.
